news.title: That CAPTCHA Asking You to Press Windows+R Is a Scam
news.excerpt: A fake CAPTCHA pops up and tells you to press the Windows key + R, paste something, and hit Enter. **Don't do it.** That "verification" is a trap — it pastes malicious code into Windows Run and executes it. Real CAPTCHAs never ask for keyboard commands. Ever.

posts.title: Firefox 157.0.1 Warns When Malware Reads Your Encrypted Traffic — Free at firefox.com
posts.summary: Firefox 157.0.1 adds a new shield icon warning when software on your PC (like corporate monitoring tools or malware) intercepts your encrypted traffic. Click the shield to see which software is doing it, then decide whether to allow it or remove it. Most people have no idea their "secure" banking session can be read by something else on their computer. Get the update free at firefox.com
posts.truth:
This doesn't mean Firefox can't protect you — it means your PC might be compromised in other ways. Most attacks don't come through the browser. They come through the software you installed. I see this every week: someone installs "free" software and it quietly installs a monitoring tool. The fix is to uninstall it at Settings > Apps > Installed Apps. Look for anything you don't recognize.
Tags: #Firefox #Security #FreeUpdate #OnyxSystems

posts.title: Windows 10 Support Ends October 14, 2026 — Free Upgrade to Windows 11 at Settings > Update
posts.summary: After October 14, 2026, Windows 10 stops receiving security updates. Your computer will keep working, but it won't be safe to use online. Upgrade to Windows 11 for free at Settings > Windows Update > Check for Updates. Most PCs from 2018 or newer are eligible. Get the free upgrade at Settings > Windows Update
posts.truth:
I see people putting this off every week. "I'll deal with it later." The problem is that October 14 isn't a deadline — it's the start of an exposure window. Every day after that, your computer is vulnerable to every new security flaw. The upgrade takes 45 minutes. Do it this weekend.
Tags: #Windows10 #EndOfSupport #Windows11 #OnyxSystems
